 Amon-Ra St. Brown Should See Heavy Target Volume in Week 7 
 1d Link copied! 
 Share: 
 Link copied to clipboard! 
 See RotoBaller at 
 the top of Google 
 Oct 24, 2026, 10:19 AM ET 
Five games into his 2026 season, Detroit Lions wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown has recorded 37 catches for 372 yards and five touchdowns on 57 targets. The 26-year-old's production has slowed down a little bit lately, as he's failed to crack 75 receiving yards in a game and has hauled in just one touchdown catch since Week 2. In Week 7, Detroit will host the Green Bay Packers. The game projects to be a high-scoring affair, but the Packers have fielded a stingy pass defense so far this season, ranking third in the NFL in yards per pass attempt allowed (6.0) and eighth in passing touchdowns allowed (seven). Still, St. Brown is averaging nearly 12 targets per game this year and has been the clear number one option in the passing game for Lions quarterback Jared Goff . St. Brown remains a high-end WR1 option for fantasy managers in Week 7. -- Will Brady

 Oct 25, 2026, 4:03 PM ET 
Houston Texans wide receiver Jaylin Noel (toe) is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 7 matchup against the New York Giants, according to KPRC 2's Aaron Wilson, and Xavier Hutchinson , who is listed behind Noel at slot receiver, could see additional opportunities if the injury sidelines him for the remainder of the game.
